correctness.rationale: Exact epoch difference maps are strict contractions of the SPD Hessian norm by a factor at most c. Solving a=c^2d+u, d=c^2a+v gives the common marginal variances. Each full epoch output conditioned on its order is a bivariate Gaussian with covariance off-diagonal -ca or -cd, regardless of the input copula, proving the displayed two-Gaussian mixture invariant and uniquely so. Exact Isserlis identity gives mixed cumulant 2p(1-p)c^2(u-v)^2/(1+c^2)^2; trace of the covariance with the Hessian gives the affine objective in p and its strict minimizer. The standalone checker passed the symbolic derivations and independent Gaussian-epoch chain simulation. No infinite conclusion rests only on samples.

originality.rationale: A fresh coordinate-permutation/noisy-oracle stationary-law question motivated by the verified 2018-03-22 noiseless quadratic-permutation paper. Read its full arXiv HTML along with a related SGD full text, the indexed full text of Chen-Ip (2014), and full published published-finding corpus results for noisy Kaczmarz and scalar reshuffling. Chen-Ip provides a general two-variable incompatible-Gibbs single-site random-scan mixture precursor, but not the full random-permutation epoch model or its exact noisy-first optimal steady-state objective and positive mixed fourth cumulant with invariant Gaussian marginals. The Kaczmarz result concerns iid with-replacement row selection and differs at the transition level; the scalar finite-sum result concerns different additive drift rather than fresh Gaussian coordinate noise. Historical equivalence remains a genuine priority risk.

value.rationale: Noise by coordinate and random reshuffling are motivated numerical optimization design choices. The complete exact epoch invariant sharply separates Gaussian marginals from non-Gaussian dependence, certifies a positive mixed cumulant invisible to univariate checks, and provides a unique, operational noisier-coordinate-first stationary loss rule with exact randomization penalty. This is a structural benchmark in full-sweep stochastic coordinate optimization rather than a narrowly selected numerical instance.
